I build native systems around coding agents: workbenches, skills, deterministic verification, memory, routing, and forensics.
Each project works alone. Together, they form a closed execution loop.

// START_WITH_A_TASK

Choose the problem you want to solve, then follow that project's setup guide.

Your task Start here
Run parallel coding agents in one native macOS workbench fibo (fibo.page)

Track Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Grok quotas & costs quotabar · ccstats
Inspect Claude routing consistency and local alerts claude-route-watch

Each repository documents its own installation, requirements, support, and license. The stack diagram below describes how the projects relate; it is not a shared installer.

// THE_CLOSED_LOOP

// FLAGSHIP_SYSTEMS

Native macOS workbench for coding agents (GPUI + libghostty): persistent daemon, live attention states, never lose a session.

High-performance Rust LLM gateway with 60+ runtime-wired providers through one OpenAI-compatible contract.
ORCHESTRATE / 04

harness

Governed fleets of parallel coding agents, powered by a Rust control plane.

 TRUST / 05

vibeguard

Scoped review rules, native Bash/Git hooks, and guardrails against unverified agent changes.

 REMEMBER / 06

Local-first, SQLCipher-encrypted memory for long-running Claude Code and Codex work.
